question: Does this installed build have a native fixed agent array/index cap, and can changing AI alone permit more than 2000 simultaneously instantiated agents?
answer: Unresolved. No native code or runtime evidence was obtained. Neither a 2000/2048 native limit nor its absence is established.

bounded_prior_evidence_review.finding: The 2048 constants observed in api-inventory.json lines 10418 and 10438 belong to Material.UsingDiffuseAlphaMap shader flags. They are not evidence of an agent cap. Numeric hits in other selected files were unrelated. This bounded search is not an exhaustive absence claim.

inferences.claim: Layered simulation can keep a bounded active set of game agents while tracking a larger logical army separately. This avoids depending on unverified native cap removal, but it is not evidence of more than 2000 simultaneous native agents.

Reducing AI cost alone does not demonstrate safe expansion of native allocation/index/storage limits; spawning, identifiers, collision, navigation, rendering and lifecycle consumers require verification.
